answer: The grove debit happens at intake, umber totals the burned amount, and ember anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm hence pays the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 29 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Bonded capital sits idle for 4 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
